definition_en: a room where lessons are taught
core_image: 一间明亮的教室，墙上贴着学生的画，课桌排成几行
scene: 一间明亮的教室墙上贴着学生的画，课桌排成几行。 The classroom is quiet before the bell.
sceneCN: 这里 classroom 是「教室」（第 01 个义项）；句意是铃响前教室很安静。

senses.title: A room where lessons are taught
senses.definition: a room in a school where lessons take place
senses.example: The classroom is quiet before the bell.
senses.why: Classroom is class plus room, the room set aside for the class to meet and learn.
senses.whyCN: classroom 是 class 加 room，就是留给班级上课的那间屋。

senses.title: Used before a noun, meaning 'of the classroom'
senses.definition: placed before another noun to mean 'belonging to the classroom'
senses.definitionCN: 放在另一名词前，表示属于课堂的
senses.example: The classroom rules are on the wall.
senses.why: A noun can stand before another noun like an adjective, so classroom in classroom rules marks the setting those rules belong to.
senses.whyCN: 名词可以像形容词一样放在另一名词前，所以 classroom rules 里的 classroom 标明这些规则属于哪个场合。

items.cn: 前半是 class，指一起上课的群体。

items.en: The second part is room, a space.
items.cn: 后半是 room，指空间。

items.en: The compound names the space for lessons.
items.cn: 这个复合词指上课的空间。

items.en: It spread with public schooling.

items.en: Classroom also names online spaces.

definition_en: to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it, or liquid for drinking
core_image: 一只杯子举到嘴边，水线一点点降下去
scene: 跑完操场的孩子满头是汗，抓起水壶一口气灌下去。 He drank the whole bottle of water after the race.
sceneCN: 这里 drink 是「喝」（第 01 个义项）；句意是她喝了一杯牛奶。

derivatives.zh: 由 drink 加 -er 构成，义为「饮酒者」
由 drink 加 -ing 构成，义为「饮用」
由 drink 加 -able 构成，义为「可饮用的」

senses.title: To take liquid into the mouth
senses.definition: to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it
senses.definitionCN: 把液体送入口中并咽下
senses.example: I drink water every morning.
senses.why: Drink is an old Germanic verb for swallowing liquid, and that physical action is its central sense.
senses.whyCN: drink 是古老的日耳曼语动词，表示咽下液体，这个具体动作是它最核心的意思。

senses.title: Liquid for drinking
senses.definition: a liquid that people drink
senses.example: Milk is a healthy drink.
senses.why: English often uses the same form for an action and its object, so the act of drinking also names what is drunk.
senses.whyCN: 英语常用同一个形式表示动作和对象，所以「喝」这个动作也指被喝的东西。

senses.title: To consume alcohol
senses.definition: to take alcoholic drinks
senses.example: He does not drink at parties.
senses.why: Because alcohol is the drink most often singled out in social rules, the bare verb drink can mean to use alcohol.
senses.whyCN: 因为在社交规范里最常被单独提起的饮品是酒，所以光用动词 drink 就能表示「喝酒」。

items.en: Drink covers water, alcohol and figurative absorption.

definition_en: a device that shows the time
core_image: 墙上的圆钟指针指向七点，窗外的天刚亮
scene: 墙上的圆钟指针指向七点，窗外的天刚亮。 The clock on the wall shows seven.
sceneCN: 这里 clock 是「时钟」（第 01 个义项）；句意是墙上的钟显示七点。

senses.title: An instrument that shows the time
senses.definition: an instrument with a dial or display that shows the time
senses.definitionCN: 带表盘或显示、用来指示时间的器具
senses.example: The clock on the wall shows seven.
senses.why: Clock came from medieval Latin clocca, 'bell', because early clocks announced the hour by ringing; the bell's name passed to the machine.
senses.whyCN: clock 来自中世纪拉丁语 clocca「钟」，因为早期时钟靠敲钟报时，钟的名字就转到了整台机器上。

senses.title: Any instrument with a measuring dial
senses.definition: a meter or dial that measures speed, distance or time
senses.definitionCN: 测量速度、里程或时间的表盘装置
senses.example: The taxi's clock showed the distance travelled.
senses.exampleCN: 出租车的计价表显示行驶的里程。
senses.why: Once the word meant a dial-driven machine, other dial meters such as a taxi's or a car's were also called clocks.
senses.whyCN: 这个词一旦指带表盘的机器，出租车、汽车上的其他表盘也被叫作 clock。

senses.title: To record time, as in clock in
senses.definition: to record one's arrival or departure time on a clock
senses.definitionCN: 用计时器记下上班或下班的时间
senses.example: Workers clock in at eight.
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb, so to clock in is to have the clock record your time.
senses.whyCN: 名词转作动词，clock in 就是让计时器记下你的时间。

definition_en: the first month of the year, between December and February
core_image: 一扇双面门，一面回望旧年，一面望向新年
scene: 一月是一年中最冷的时候。 January is the coldest time of the year.

senses.definition: the first month of the calendar year, with thirty-one days

senses.example: January has thirty-one days.
senses.why: The month is named for the god of doorways because it stands at the year's entrance.
senses.whyCN: 这个月以门神命名，因为它站在一年的入口处。

senses.title: The season of new beginnings
senses.definition: the month understood as the start of a fresh year and its plans

senses.exampleCN: 一月是制定新计划的时候。

senses.whyCN: 因为排在最前，这个月自然承载希望、决心与重新开始。

senses.exampleCN: 一月大减价让商店挤满了人。
senses.why: A fixed month gathers shared experience, from deep cold to after-holiday bargains.
senses.whyCN: 固定的月份聚集共同经验，从严寒到节后打折。

definition_en: the twelfth month of the year, between November and January
core_image: 夜色里一串串彩灯，把冬天的街道照亮
scene: 十二月街上挂满彩灯，大家都在准备过节。 In December the streets are full of lights, and everyone is getting ready for the holidays.

senses.title: The twelfth month of the year
senses.definition: the twelfth and last month of the calendar year, with thirty-one days
senses.definitionCN: 公历年的第十二个月，也是最后一个月，有三十一天
senses.example: December is the last month of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 十二月是一年的最后一个月。
senses.why: The name means ten in an older count, but the month now closes the year.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字在旧计数中意为十，但如今它为一年的收尾。

senses.title: The heart of winter
senses.definition: the month felt as the depth of winter, with short days and long nights
senses.definitionCN: 被感受为冬天深处、昼短夜长的月份
senses.example: Nights are long in December.
senses.why: Near the solstice the dark hours stretch, so the month feels like winter's centre.
senses.whyCN: 接近冬至，黑夜拉长，因此这个月像冬天的中心。

senses.title: The month of holidays
senses.definition: the month used for winter holidays, lights, and year-end celebrations
senses.definitionCN: 用于冬季节庆、彩灯和年末庆祝的月份
senses.example: The shops are busy in December.
senses.why: Holidays and the year's end invite gifts, lights, and gatherings.
senses.whyCN: 节日与岁末邀请人们送礼、点灯和聚会。

definition_en: a book in which you write about your days
core_image: 床头柜上放着一个带锁的小本子，封面夹着一支笔
scene: 床头柜上放着一个带锁的小本子，封面夹着一支笔。 She writes in her diary before bed.
sceneCN: 这里 diary 是「日记本」（第 01 个义项）；句意是她睡前在日记本上写几行。

senses.title: A book with a page for each day
senses.definition: a book with a space or page for each day of the year
senses.definitionCN: 按日期一页一天的本子
senses.example: She writes in her diary before bed.
senses.exampleCN: 她睡前在日记本上写几行。
senses.why: Latin dies, day, gave diarium, a daily allowance or record, and English kept it for the book that holds one page per day.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 dies「日」构成 diarium，指按日分配的记录，英语用它指一天一页的本子。

senses.title: A daily record of your life
senses.definition: the daily record itself, written in such a book
senses.definitionCN: 写在这种本子里的逐日记录
senses.example: His diary tells what he did each day.
senses.exampleCN: 他的日记记下他每天做了什么。
senses.why: The container and the contents share one name: the same word that names the book also names what is written inside it.
senses.whyCN: 本子和内容共用同一个名字：指本子的词，也指写在里面的记录。

senses.title: A book for planning appointments
senses.definition: a book in which you write appointments and things to do
senses.definitionCN: 用来记约会和待办事项的本子
senses.example: She checked her diary for the meeting time.
senses.exampleCN: 她翻了翻日程本，看会议时间。
senses.why: In British use the dated book was turned to planning ahead, so diary also names the book that holds future appointments.
senses.whyCN: 在英国用法里，按日期编排的本子被用来安排以后的事，diary 也就指记未来约会的本子。
